summary: ReNew Energy Global plc filed a 6-K announcing a confirmatory letter from Canada Pension Plan Investment Board and Founder/CEO Sumant Sinha, reaffirming their July 27, 2026 best and final non-binding proposal to acquire all shares not already owned by the Consortium for US$7.02 per share in cash, subject to a rollover. The Special Committee, led by Manoj Singh and advised by Rothschild Co and Linklaters, is evaluating the proposal. Active discussions continue with no assurance of deal completion. Watch for Special Committee's conclusive update and any competing bids or improved terms.
